coder: OpenAI Codex; post-hoc single AI coder; no independent second coder
unit: One submitted free-text reason; multiple labels allowed; counts are overlapping

rules.text: Answer wording, plausibility without scene input, or supplied description used as the evidence source. Description-stage reasons receive this tag in addition to any specific evidence content.
rules.scene_object: Stated scene, object, person, or activity identity/presence/absence; includes descriptions, not only pixels.
rules.spatial: Explicit position or relation, e.g. across a counter, below, beside, or at an edge.
rules.gesture_gaze: Explicit hand extension/grip or gaze as an interaction cue; absence of such a cue may also be cited.
rules.temporal_interaction: Explicit repetition, sequence, already-in-progress state, or next-step timing used in the rationale.

limits: These codes characterize participant statements, not verified frame content or causal mechanisms. Negative evidence is coded when explicitly invoked. Do not equate evidence content with input modality. No inter-rater reliability is available.
